subject: Renewal walkthrough & demo — compact slot bid and ops coordination
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kate Lawson <kate.lawson@medixco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 16:15:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal walkthrough & demo — compact slot bid and ops coordination

Hi Kate — thanks again for the thoughtful conversation last week. As we discussed, for your renewal QBR I want to run a focused 45-minute roadmap demo that highlights: 1) cost-optimizations using Redwood Optimize, 2) dedicated routing for compliance workloads, and 3) a short ops-runbook for warm failover.

Options for slots (all PST):
- Option A: Thu Jan 12, 10:00–10:45am PST
- Option B: Thu Jan 12, 2:00–2:45pm PST
- Option C: Fri Jan 13, 9:00–9:45am PST (backup)

Can you confirm which slot is best for the core platform stakeholders (your CTO and SRE lead)? If those times don't work we can compact into a 30-minute demo plus async pre-read. I attached a lightweight agenda and an initial mutual action plan to make cross-team prep easier.

Quick ask for your side: who will own the compliance questions during the demo so we can prep the right logs/screens?

Thanks — looking forward.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: QBR_Agenda.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]
[Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)]

From: Kate Lawson <kate.lawson@medixco.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 14:23:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal walkthrough & demo — compact slot bid and ops coordination

Hi Markus — thanks for sending options and the agenda. Quick note: our CTO is in travel on Jan 12 for an investor meeting and won't be available until late Friday. Chris (cc'd) will own the technical Q&A, but some procurement folks want an exec-friendly 30-minute window where strategy + commercial asks are front-and-center.

Can we do Option C (Fri Jan 13, 9:00am PST) as the live session but compress the live demo to 30 minutes (20m demo + 10m Q&A), and then ship the deeper technical appendix as an async recording + the mutual action plan updated with timelines? That would work better for us.

Also — for compliance questions, I'll have Jenna Torres from Security on standby; she can jump in for the first 10 minutes of Q&A.

Cheers,
Kate
Kate Lawson
Head of Platform, MedixCo
(kate.lawson@medixco.com)

Kate — perfect, appreciate the clarity. Fri Jan 13, 09:00–09:30am PST is reserved for you. We'll compress the live portion to the executive highlights you requested and provide a ~25-minute recording that walks through the deeper knobs (batching, quantization recommendations, routing policies) for the SRE/infra team.

Action items for us (internal):
- Laura: prepare a 20-slide exec-friendly flow (10m product + 10m ROI/cost case).
- Monica: prep the short technical appendix recording and the quantization recommendation slide.
- Mark: update the mutual action plan with target dates (I added a placeholder).

Kate — I'll put a provisional calendar invite on Friday with a Google Meet link; please confirm once Jenna and Chris are OK. Also including a DocuSign link for the modest renewal amendment we'll need signed post-demo (low-touch).

Onwards —
— Markus
